description: The bar chart illustrates the "effect" of six different models across four categorical tags. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "tag", which include "case", "gender", "number", and a fourth category whose label is obscured by a solid grey rectangle. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "effect", using a linear scale that ranges from slightly below 0 to over 20, with numeric tick labels at intervals of 5 and corresponding horizontal grid lines. The chart features grouped bars, with each group containing six bars corresponding to different models as indicated by the legend: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light red), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). Every bar is outlined in black and includes a capped black error bar. The "case" category contains the tallest bars, with mBERT-B₂ reaching approximately 12.5 and XLM-B₂ at roughly 11.5, both featuring large error bars extending up to approximately 21 and 20, respectively. The values generally decrease across the subsequent categories. In the "gender" group, values range from about 0.5 for XLM-L₂ to 4.0 for mBERT-B₂. The "number" group shows values between approximately 0.5 for XLM-R₂ and 2.5 for mBERT-B₂. The final, obscured category contains the shortest bars, with values hovering near zero, including mBERT-R₂ which dips slightly below zero to approximately -0.1. The categories are not sorted in a specific ascending or descending order, though within each group, the mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ bars consistently display the highest values.
